title: approvals: a decided first-step request's page shows an empty "Approval progress" card
body:
## What happens

On the approval request page (`sys_approval_request` record, `ApprovalDecisionPanel`), the right rail's **Approval progress** card (zh-CN 「审批进度」) renders only its title, with an empty body, when the request is the **first approval step of its run and is already decided** (approved or rejected).

Seen on an app deployment (a 4-step sequential quote approval, one `approval` node per step): the step-1 request, approved, shows

- header: Status **Approved**, Step = step 1's label;
- Activity card: submit + approve rows, as expected;
- **Approval progress card: title only, nothing under it.**

A reader takes the empty card as "something is broken", or as "the whole approval is done", while the record's own approval (step 2 onward) is still running.

## Why (read from source, `main` at 34834073)

The card body is three parts (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx`, the `approval-decision-progress` RailCard):

1. `<ApprovalStepLine steps={request.flow_route?.steps} />`
   - `flowRoute` (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-route.ts`) returns `[...passedSteps, own]` once the row is not `pending`: no steps ahead are drawn for a decided request.
   - For a first-step request `passedSteps` is empty, so `steps` has length 1.
   - `ApprovalStepLine` returns `null` when `steps.length < 2` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-progress/ApprovalStepLine.tsx`).
2. `{progress && <DecisionProgressIndicator …/>}`: no `decision_progress` on a single-approver decided step.
3. `<PendingApprovers …/>`: nobody is pending on a decided request.

All three render nothing, so the card is an empty shell. The same holds for a decided request of a one-step flow.

## Expected

One of:

- **(a)** Draw the card's step line for a decided request even with one step, e.g. "① Step 1 ✓ Approved", plus a line saying whether the run went on (the record's approval continues at the next step / the approval ended); or
- **(b)** Do not render the card when none of its three parts has anything to show.

(a) is more useful: the reader of a decided step request wants to know where the record's approval stands now. `flow_route.ahead` is already `'decided'` there, so the UI can tell this case apart.

## Repro

1. A record-change or submit flow with two sequential `approval` nodes (step 1 → step 2), single approver each.
2. Submit a record; approve step 1.
3. Open step 1's `sys_approval_request` record page.
4. Observed: the Approval progress card is empty. Expected: per (a) or (b) above.
